opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; early‑career, postdoctoral status; UK citizenship or EEA nationals; must have completed viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships for early‑career researchers to conduct independent research leading to a publishable output, funded at 80 % of salary costs under the FEC regime.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or IRO, working in the humanities or social sciences; eligible to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills.
opportunities.summary: Six‑ to twelve‑month awards up to £10,000 to support skill‑development, collaboration and dissemination activities for established researchers in the humanities and social sciences.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation position; must be able to relieve teaching/administrative duties; lead applicant plus up to two co‑applicants from different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding of up to £200,000 for interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects bridging the British Academy, Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering remits, lasting up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher in the humanities or social sciences; open to all career stages; must have prior public‑engagement experience; cannot have previously received this award.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement awards up to £8,000 for projects delivering innovative activities with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, running between April 2027 and December 2028.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators from the humanities or social sciences, holding an established role; must collaborate with overseas co‑applicants and demonstrate genuine interdisciplinarity across SHAPE or STEM fields.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year awards up to £300,000 (80 % FEC) for internationally collaborative interdisciplinary projects on the theme of Mobilities, beginning March/April 2027.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑ or mid‑career UK‑based researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be based at a UK institution; placed in DGAP office in Berlin for 12 months.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000) to develop skills, networks and policy‑relevant research in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology/AI and European strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funding to enable up to fifteen UK early‑career researchers to attend a three‑day symposium in April 2027 and develop collaborative proposals; seed funding available for post‑symposium projects.
